Pakistan beat India by three wickets in U-19 Asia Cup
 India were bowled out for a modest 208 and Pakistan, after a top-order wobble, managed to complete the chase, with Hamza Zahoor taking the team home with an excellent, unbeaten 100 off 108 balls after coming in at number seven
 Updated - November 08, 2026 07:13 pm IST - Al Amerat (Oman) 
 PTI READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Arjun Rajput top-scored for India with an aggressive 107 off 85 balls, and his knock included 11 fours and five sixes. File
 Pakistan defeated India by three wickets in their men's U-19 Asia Cup match in Oman on Sunday (November 8, 2026).
 India were bowled out for a modest 208 and Pakistan, after a top-order wobble, managed to complete the chase, with Hamza Zahoor taking the team home with an excellent, unbeaten 100 off 108 balls after coming in at number seven.
 Earlier, Arjun Rajput top-scored for India with an aggressive 107 off 85 balls, and his knock included 11 fours and five sixes. Both Aryavir Sehwag (22) and Anvay Dravid (10) were dismissed cheaply.
 Manal Chauhan picked up 3/32 in 10 overs for India.
 Brief scores:
 India U-19: 208 in 46.3 overs (Arjun Rajput 107, Ali Raza 3/37).
 Pakistan U-19: 209/7 in 48.1 overs (Hamza Zahoor 100 not out; Manal Chauhan 3/32).
